shared_mutation_parameters.mutation_surface: top-side lug around the through-bolt hole
shared_mutation_parameters.cutout_recipe: HARD has a blind top lug and continuous bore only after mating; COMMUTABLE adds a visible captive pocket that retains the bolt without blocking mating
shared_mutation_parameters.visible_evidence: the blind lug or captive pocket is visible in the top-side close view

variant_parameters.feasibility_reason: the 18.00 mm visible pocket retains the bolt head with 1.50 mm clearance during closure

render_collision_contract.render_feature: generated from the recipe's cutout/slot/pocket primitive
render_collision_contract.collision_feature: the exact same primitive dimensions and transform, decomposed only for solver stability
forbidden: solid convex hull over an opening

required_checks: canonical A>B succeeds in both variants
reverse B>A fails for HARD and succeeds for COMMUTABLE
zero penetration at start and terminal stability
camera close view exposes the changed feature
same controller and seeds are used for paired variants
